evaluations.rationale: Selected. It is the only plan whose first action both reproduces the superlinear behavior and yields a bounded timing threshold, then proceeds to a structural repair. The pair split is isolated from attribute parsing, and the falsifier is directly measurable. Evidence at this point was source inspection and a scouting probe, not a saved run result.

Deferred in favor of the broader selected plan. The doubling-step timing design is useful and was incorporated, but the strict-only framing was too narrow: scouting showed the permissive mode also scaled superlinearly. Its equals-bearing and no-whitespace controls remain valuable.

Deferred, not refuted. Its semicolon-placement discriminator is the strongest single test of whether the sink is pair matching rather than semicolon stripping or attribute parsing. The check was incorporated into the selected action.

Deferred as a distinct secondary-mechanism hypothesis. The value class appears linear in source, but the test is coherent and would detect a second stage dominating after pair repair. Lower priority because the pair-split overlap already explains the observed scaling.

Deferred until a patch exists. Its baseline-versus-patch semantic differential is exactly the regression check required after repair, but it cannot discriminate the causal mechanism first. It became the principal verification design in a later step.
